diff --git a/.github/workflows/capture-and-publish.yml b/.github/workflows/capture-and-publish.yml
index 8160ab3..ced239f 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/capture-and-publish.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/capture-and-publish.yml
@@ -1,63 +1,65 @@
 name: Capture Changes and Publish
 
 on:
   push:
     branches:
       - main
   workflow_dispatch:
 
 permissions:
   contents: write
   pages: write
   id-token: write
 
 concurrency:
   group: pages
   cancel-in-progress: false
 
 jobs:
   capture-and-publish:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    environment:
+      name: github-pages
+      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
 
     steps:
       - name: Checkout full history
         uses: actions/checkout@v4
         with:
           fetch-depth: 0
 
       - name: Capture exact push diff
         env:
           GITHUB_EVENT_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
           GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
           GITHUB_EVENT_PATH: ${{ github.event_path }}
           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
           GITHUB_SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
           GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
-        run: |
-          python3 scripts/capture-diff.py
+        run: python3 scripts/capture-diff.py
 
       - name: Commit generated scan data
         run: |
           git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
           git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
 
           git add data/latest.json data/index.json data/scans
           if git diff --cached --quiet; then
             echo "No generated data changes to commit."
           else
             git commit -m "ci: capture push diff [skip ci]"
             git push
           fi
 
       - name: Configure GitHub Pages
         uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
 
       - name: Upload Pages artifact
         uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
         with:
           path: .
 
       - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
         id: deployment
         uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
